\begin{example} \end{example}[HNN extensions] ↗ thm:graph-of-groups-is-kg1 1. ch1:1B.13\group Fundamental Group

For monomorphisms $\varphi ,\psi :C\to A$, the one-vertex one-edge graph of groups has group generated by $A$ and $t$ with relations $t\varphi (c)t^{-1}=\psi (c)$. Equal maps give $A\times \Z $, and an automorphism gives $A\rtimes \Z $. \end{example}
